Cifras compiladas siguiendo los lineamientos del Sexto Manual de Balanza de Pagos y Posición de Inversión Internacional (MBP6), último manual publicado por el FMI y aplicado por Bolivia desde 2016.

El marco muestral (MM-2012) está basada con los datos del Censo de Población y Vivienda de 2012 (CNPV-2012), la Actualización Cartográfica Multipropósito (ACM-2010-2012) y el Censo Nacional Agropecuario de 2013 (CNA-2013).

_dropped.why: INE's Census 2024 methodology documentation confirms literacy/attainment is a census-questionnaire-derived topic, but this only reaffirms the node's existing part_of: bo-censo container relationship (invalid edge). No document ties it to a different corpus node.
Same census documentation lists language spoken as a questionnaire topic, again only reaffirming its existing part_of: bo-censo container relationship. No other target found.

A UNFPA-published Census 2024 bulletin confirms Quechua/Aymara nation figures come from the census autoidentificación question, but its container is bo-autoidentificacion (itself part_of bo-censo) — no document ties this node to a different corpus node such as bo-tioc despite thematic overlap.

As the primary field-collection instrument, has no upstream data dependency. Its methodology documentation cites prior censuses and, once, a UN data-editing manual — too thin/unversioned to mint per standing policy against generic standards citations.
The actual Programa Monetario 2026 PDF narrates inflation/labour context for policy targets with zero 'Fuente:' citations or named source-report references, unlike BCB's BOP report.

Every page/PDF on economiayfinanzas.gob.bo is unreachable: TLS handshake shows an incomplete certificate chain (missing intermediate for the Sectigo-issued leaf cert), confirmed via openssl s_client across multiple retries and an alternate subdomain — a genuine site-side misconfiguration, not a proxy artifact.
